tasks.name: Algorithmic Dynamic Programming (0/1 Knapsack)
tasks.prompt: Write a clean Python function knapsack(weights, values, W) using 1D space-optimized DP. What is the return value for weights=[10, 20, 30], values=[60, 100, 120], W=50? Give the final numeric answer clearly.

tasks.name: Mathematical Deduction (Harmonic Mean Velocity)
tasks.prompt: A train travels 120 miles from City A to City B at 60 mph, and immediately returns along the same 120-mile route from City B to City A at 40 mph. What is the average speed for the entire round trip? Show your calculation and give the final exact number.
